# Unit of Measure (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Unit of Measure` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-unit) | `GET /ref/unit?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-unit) | `POST /ref/unit` |
| [PUT](#put-ref-unit) | `PUT /ref/unit` |
| [DELETE](#delete-ref-unit) | `DELETE /ref/unit?ID={ID}` |


Unit of Measure CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Unit of Measure

## Unit of Measure

Path: `/ref/unit`

<a id="get-ref-unit"></a>
### GET /ref/unit?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `Name` (optional): Only return units of measure that start with the specific name

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 1,
  "Page": 1,
  "UnitList": [
    {
      "ID": "999b3f55-78f5-4a1f-ba8b-2be682a0af61",
      "Name": "Item"
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="post-ref-unit"></a>
### POST /ref/unit

Request body:

```json
{
  "Name": "Item"
}
```

Response 200:

```json
{
  "ID": "999b3f55-78f5-4a1f-ba8b-2be682a0af61",
  "Name": "Item"
}
```

<a id="put-ref-unit"></a>
### PUT /ref/unit

Request body:


Response 200:
